candidates.applicability: Public types in library or public crate API surfaces; redaction and justified omission remain manual.

evidence.invalid_fixture: invalid fixture emits the exact diagnostic on both toolchains
evidence.valid_fixture: derived Debug produces no candidate diagnostic
evidence.exception_fixture: protected fields and compile-size policy cannot be decided by the lint
evidence.repair: revision M public-type repair used the existing RUST-API-001 authority
evidence.preservation: revision M preserved clean controls and public behavior
evidence.churn: revision M passed its exact changed-scope gate
evidence.blind_review: revision M blind reviewers accepted all repairs; the lint itself grants no repair

candidates.rationale: The diagnostic precisely identifies missing Debug, but cannot choose derive, redacted manual output, or an accepted omission.

candidates.concern: Unsafe operations or contracts lack explicit structural evidence
candidates.applicability: Unsafe blocks, functions, traits, implementations, raw pointers, and FFI; content and soundness remain manual.

evidence.invalid_fixture: invalid fixture emits all three normalized identifiers
evidence.valid_fixture: explicit unsafe block, Safety docs, and concrete comment emit none
evidence.exception_fixture: E0133 is an error code rather than the lint name; manual source context remains required
evidence.repair: strict repair remains report-only; no detector-authored repair was run
evidence.preservation: revisions J-M preserved unsafe fixtures byte-for-byte
evidence.churn: zero unsafe-boundary churn was required by the strict evidence gate
evidence.blind_review: revision M reviewers accepted the report-only unsafe disposition

candidates.rationale: The checks enforce visible structure. They cannot prove that the documented invariants discharge the exact unsafe operation contract.

candidates.concern: A lock guard or RefCell borrow crosses an await point
candidates.applicability: std/parking_lot lock guards and RefCell borrows live across await; cancellation and state consistency remain manual.

evidence.invalid_fixture: both guard diagnostics fire on both toolchains
evidence.valid_fixture: lexical scope before await emits neither diagnostic
evidence.repair: revision M repaired the blocking-lock case under RUST-ASYNC-001
evidence.preservation: revision M preserved behavior and clean controls
evidence.churn: revision M passed exact scope and churn gates
evidence.blind_review: revision M reviewers accepted the lock-scope repair

candidates.rationale: The live guard is a strong actionable signal, but changing lock type or state transitions still requires source review.

candidates.concern: A standard-library item is newer than the configured MSRV
candidates.applicability: Packages with resolved rust-version or equivalent Clippy MSRV configuration.

evidence.invalid_fixture: OnceLock against rust-version 1.60 emits the diagnostic on both toolchains
evidence.valid_fixture: Once against the same MSRV emits no diagnostic
evidence.exception_fixture: feature-local MSRV overrides and dependencies require repository policy
evidence.repair: detector proposes no version-policy change; equivalent replacement uses existing rule authority
evidence.preservation: minimum-toolchain validation remains mandatory after any replacement
evidence.churn: only the incompatible item may enter repair scope
evidence.blind_review: no new repair class was promoted; version-policy changes remain operator decisions

candidates.rationale: The lint is precise for known library stabilization data but does not replace an actual minimum-toolchain build or cover every dependency and language feature.

candidates.concern: Published documentation contains an unresolved intra-doc link
candidates.applicability: Public documentation built with the repository's normal rustdoc configuration.

evidence.invalid_fixture: broken link emits the exact rustdoc diagnostic on both toolchains
evidence.valid_fixture: link to a public type emits no diagnostic
evidence.exception_fixture: document-private-items changes private-link behavior and must be recorded
evidence.repair: evidence-only; no new automatic or detector-owned repair
evidence.preservation: a repair must preserve the intended API target and documentation meaning
evidence.churn: only the broken link and required rename context may change
evidence.blind_review: no normative rule or repair authority was added, so a new blind repair cohort was not claimed

candidates.rationale: Resolution is mechanical under a fixed rustdoc configuration; the intended replacement target is still a human API decision.

candidates.concern: Public Result or panic behavior lacks Errors or Panics documentation
candidates.applicability: Public functions in documented API surfaces; generated, private, and intentionally opaque APIs need policy.

evidence.invalid_fixture: both diagnostics fire on the invalid public API fixture
evidence.valid_fixture: complete Errors and Panics sections emit neither diagnostic
evidence.exception_fixture: panic detection is incomplete and local expect/allow annotations may encode proven invariants
evidence.preservation: error contracts must be traced before documentation changes

candidates.rationale: Useful evidence, but incomplete panic discovery and absent repair review block normative promotion.

candidates.concern: Production code uses unwrap, expect, panic, or unchecked indexing
candidates.applicability: Leads in production paths; tests, consts, poisoned locks, bounds, and proven invariants require classification.

evidence.invalid_fixture: restriction lints identify syntax but not recoverability
evidence.valid_fixture: absence does not prove explicit failure semantics
evidence.exception_fixture: tracked exception fixture triggers on caller-established bounds, an invariant expect, and test setup
evidence.repair: revision M repair required call-path and input-boundary judgment
evidence.preservation: revision M protected behavior and clean controls
evidence.blind_review: revision M reviewed the contextual repair, not lint output alone

candidates.rationale: These remain selective search leads. Enabling the restriction group or treating each hit as a finding would be noisy.

candidates.concern: Cancellation at an await point loses data or leaves inconsistent state
candidates.applicability: Async operations that can be dropped at suspension, especially select loops and stateful I/O.

evidence.invalid_fixture: no syntax-only fixture can establish lost semantic state
evidence.valid_fixture: API-specific cancellation contracts and state flow are required
evidence.exception_fixture: the same await syntax is safe or unsafe depending on the future's contract
evidence.churn: not measurable without a concrete operation
evidence.blind_review: not eligible without a concrete repair cohort

candidates.rationale: Cancellation safety is an operation contract and state-machine property, not a general AST pattern.

candidates.concern: Public API or crate documentation is absent
candidates.applicability: Repository-selected public library and application API surfaces.

evidence.valid_fixture: present text can still be useless or wrong
evidence.exception_fixture: binaries, generated bindings, and deliberately hidden surfaces differ by policy
evidence.churn: blanket enablement can create broad comment churn

candidates.rationale: Documentation scope and quality remain repository-owned and meaning-dependent.

candidates.concern: Risk-bearing behavior lacks sufficient focused tests
candidates.applicability: Changed behavior and risk boundaries under repository-owned test policy.

evidence.invalid_fixture: test count cannot establish behavioral coverage
evidence.valid_fixture: a small focused test can be sufficient
evidence.exception_fixture: compile-fail, property, integration, and external-service evidence have different roles
evidence.preservation: tests must verify rather than redefine behavior
evidence.blind_review: not eligible as a syntax detector

candidates.rationale: Presence, count, or coverage percentage cannot decide whether the relevant behavior and failure modes are tested.

candidates.concern: Responsibilities, modules, or dependency direction are poorly shaped

evidence.invalid_fixture: no local syntax fixture establishes responsibility ownership
evidence.valid_fixture: generated, protocol-shaped, and boundary code legitimately matches these patterns
evidence.exception_fixture: repository architecture determines cohesion and direction
evidence.preservation: a detector-driven move can break public and dependency boundaries

candidates.rationale: Local lint shape is not architecture evidence and would encourage laundering code around thresholds.

candidates.concern: Functions or types exceed generic complexity thresholds
candidates.applicability: Repository-selected trend evidence only; never an architecture verdict.

evidence.invalid_fixture: low configured thresholds produce all three diagnostics
evidence.valid_fixture: threshold success does not establish readability
evidence.exception_fixture: tracked exception fixture contains simple protocol-shaped code that triggers configured limits
evidence.preservation: splitting code can hide invariants and worsen locality
evidence.churn: threshold compliance encourages arbitrary helper churn
evidence.blind_review: Clippy itself states cognitive complexity is not measurable by this lint

candidates.rationale: Keep as optional trend leads. Clippy explicitly warns that cognitive_complexity is not a comprehension measure.

candidates.concern: A function only forwards arguments without an independent responsibility
candidates.applicability: Candidate inventory only; façades, visibility seams, trait adapters, and stable APIs require manual classification.

evidence.invalid_fixture: revision M exact-locality fixture identifies the unnecessary wrapper
evidence.valid_fixture: revision M keeps the documented façade
evidence.exception_fixture: public visibility alone was proven insufficient; responsibility evidence is required
evidence.repair: the candidate never supplied repair authority
evidence.preservation: revision M preserved the justified façade
evidence.churn: revision M exact scope gate passed
evidence.blind_review: revision M reviewers accepted manual candidate dispositions

candidates.rationale: The pinned scanner is captured by the Cargo-native evidence adapter and supports a total candidate ledger across its declared path coverage, not automatic deletion or normative promotion.

candidates.concern: Production code contains todo! or unimplemented! residue
candidates.applicability: Production paths; examples, teaching code, deliberate compile-fail tests, and staged scaffolds require policy.

evidence.valid_fixture: absence does not prove implementation completeness
evidence.exception_fixture: tests and intentional scaffolds can use these macros
evidence.preservation: replacement requires the missing behavior contract

candidates.rationale: Useful residue evidence, but a detector cannot invent the missing behavior or classify intentional scaffolding.
